title: Director of Partner Marketing
location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
description:
At Scale, we develop reliable AI systems for the world’s most important decisions. Our marketing team builds pipeline and brand across Scale’s enterprise, public sector, and frontier AI businesses, working closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering.
 This role owns marketing’s partner-sourced pipeline. You will turn Scale’s relationships with CSPs, hyperscalers, and other strategic partners into qualified opportunities that our sales team accepts and closes. You will work with our Partnerships team, who own the commercial relationships. Your job is to help those relationships produce revenue: mapping accounts with partner field teams, building co-sell plays, and putting Scale in front of the buyers our partners already know.
 The partner channel is one of Scale’s biggest growth levers. As it scales, so does this role. The group who builds it shapes Scale goes to market with the world’s largest platforms, and their scope will grow with the channel. This is a new function at Scale, and you will build it from 0 to 1. You will report to the VP of Marketing and carry a pipeline target. We are looking for someone who has done this inside or alongside a hyperscaler or channel partner, knows how partner field organizations work, and can open doors in their first weeks.
 You will:
 Own a partner-sourced leads pipeline targets and report against it weekly.
 Build and run co-sell motions with AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft field teams. That includes account mapping, target-account plans, and joint pursuits in priority verticals.
 Use partner programs to generate demand efficiently: listings and private offers, co-sell programs, partner funding, and joint account-based campaigns and events.
 Build relationships with partner marketing, alliance, and field sales leaders, so Scale becomes a solution their sellers bring to customers.
 Partner with Partner GTM leadership and Ops on lead handoff, acceptance criteria, and follow-up, so partner-sourced opportunities…

title: Anthropic Research Resident
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.
 What to expect
 A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
 Access to Claude models and GPU compute
 Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
 Interview process
 The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.
 Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.
 You may be a good fit if you
 Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
 Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time
 Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)
 Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
 Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly
 Strong candidates may also
 Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
 Have experience with LLMs, reinforc…

title: Director, Foundations
description:
Opportunity  

As a Director, you will lead on the development and delivery of strategic communications plans and provide senior-level advice to a broad range of clients in the foundations and non-profit sector. You will develop and land regular and proactive ideas for clients, advising on critical issues impacting some of the world’s most influential businesses and playing a leading role as day-to-day point of contact for your clients.

You will also develop strategies to approach and cultivate new business targets using a strong internal network that includes talent from across Brunswick’s entire offering, as well as your own external network.

You will ensure the smooth running of teams by establishing clear roles, managing performance, and ensuring that all key stakeholders and client needs are being covered by the team. You will work closely with Partners on all aspects of client management, including account finances, fee negotiation, and adviser meetings.

About the Role

  • Significantly contribute to the development and enhancement of Brunswick’s Foundations and Non-Profits practice in the UK, Europe, Africa, and globally; by deepening our expertise and building a world-class practice that will deliver outstanding work.
  • Understand and articulate the issues and challenges facing philanthropy; working with clients and colleagues to translate these issues into meaningful programmes which align with and ultimately enhance the respective client’s wider business strategy.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients; partnering with them and helping them define and articulate their position across a range of audiences and stakeholder groups.
  • Drive at least one major global client account
  • Foster ‘big idea’ generation, innovation and activation across the sector, driving colleagues and teams to bring ideas to life.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
The Role..

We are looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to join our data team to enhance our data-platform. This role will develop advanced analytics features into our transformations layer, optimise performance, and work with data engineers to ensure scalability and robustness.

Candidates for the role will have proven expertise in developing complex and performant SQL data models, with a deep understanding of dbt Core or dbt Cloud and Snowflake. The ideal candidate will have experience managing semantic layer based BI tools, such as Omni or Looker.

Key Responsibilities..

  • Develop advanced and performant SQL transformations in dbt to support complex analytics and reporting needs, ensuring optimised performance in handling large-scale data.
  • Optimise sql codebase for Snowflake credit spend and dbt build times, tune materialisations and incremental models, and report against build KPIs.
  • Set up and manage dbt projects to ensure that the codebase is stable, scalable, and maintainable, adhering to best practices for long-term success.
  • Administer and manage dbt Cloud (Fusion), including scheduling and job monitoring.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure our transformation layer integrates seamlessly with our ingestion layer, enabling end-to-end analytics pipelines.
